title: Prism-backed conclusion and guarantee-first capability policy
purpose: Make conclusion-class RedCap outputs multi-perspective by default, and make new capabilities prefer executable guarantees over oral agreements.
official_conclusion_definition: A RedCap official conclusion is any answer, report, task state, roadmap decision, release posture, architecture classification, risk verdict, completion claim, or governance decision that is meant to guide future engineering work.
non_official_boundary: A single main-agent reply that has not entered Prism, task report, closeout, receipt, or a tracked policy is only a proposal or first-pass interpretation. It must not be described as a joint reviewed verdict.

examples: Layer A/B or Prism role classification
historical debt vs active tranche vs future evolution

allowed_non_prism_outputs.rule: A reply may restate a current command result, receipt field, or tracked policy without a new Prism run, if it cites the source and does not add a new engineering verdict.
A reply may offer a main-agent proposal before Prism, but must label it as proposal/first-pass and must not call it a joint verdict.
A reply that only explains an already-tracked mechanism in plain language does not require a new Prism run unless it changes the mechanism or draws a new risk/completion/release conclusion.

prism_evidence_requirement.preferred: formal Prism run with at least two responded/schema_ok reviewers from distinct available model families
prism_evidence_requirement.resource_limited: resource-limited-pass is allowed only when prism-availability, provider policy, attempted providers, and blocker-free responded evidence are recorded
forbidden: claiming a main-agent opinion as a joint Prism verdict
using prism/runs directory count as proof
skipping Prism because the answer feels obvious

guarantee_first_capability_rule.default: When RedCap adds a capability, rule, workflow node, or recurring discipline, first evaluate whether it can be enforced through a script, validator, hook, acceptance case, receipt, diagnose/spec-check gate, or execution-guarantee entry.
guarantee_first_capability_rule.allowed_downgrade: A capability may remain documented/manual-only only after the task records why stricter automation is unnecessary, unsafe, or host-limited.
minimum_record: how future closeout can detect drift

plan_only_follow_up_requirement.default: When an official conclusion says a task is design-complete, plan-complete, route-only, or partial-with-explicit-defer, the conclusion must also name what is not done and where each deferred apply or follow-up item is durably tracked.
acceptable_tracking_surfaces: explicit no-follow-up justification with owner surface
minimum_follow_up_record: blocking relationship to current release or current parent task
acceptance boundary for closing the follow-up
forbidden: treating plan-complete as physical apply complete
leaving required future work only inside prose
requiring Norven's memory to rediscover a deferred apply task

coordinator_observed_flaw_requirement.default: If the Prism coordinator or Cap observes a substantive flaw in Prism synthesis, verdict framing, evidence coverage, or completion semantics, the coordinator must record the flaw and trigger follow-up, council, deadlock, or durable follow-up registration before consensus can be claimed.
substantive_flaw_examples: reviewers answered a narrower question than the task asked
the synthesis omits a blocker or mislabels a mechanism-only result as root outcome complete
the conclusion conflicts with PM Gate, completion semantics, package safety, or privacy boundaries
resource-limited evidence is presented as full quorum
allowed_resolutions: follow-up prompt and updated parsed verdict
task/backlog follow-up with owner, trigger and acceptance boundary
explicit resource-limited boundary with no completion claim
forbidden: silently overriding Prism without recording the defect
claiming consensus while coordinator-observed substantive flaws remain open

host_limited_boundary: RedCap can fail-close tracked official conclusions and closeout claims, but cannot honestly promise a physical pre-send veto for every Codex.app live chat sentence until the host exposes and proves such a hook.
must_not_claim: Every live chat sentence is physically intercepted by RedCap
A single Cap answer is automatically a Prism verdict
Documented-only rules are equivalent to executable guarantees
Resource-limited Prism is the same as full quorum
Plan-complete means physical apply is complete
